## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.0-beta.1 can draft reviewed updates to code-backed topic memories when their declared supporting code changes.

### Source-driven topic maintenance (experimental)

Enroll a durable topic memory with its supporting code, and Threadnote can detect declared evidence changes, prepare a bounded update draft with your selected local model, and show it for review. You can inspect and edit the draft before accepting it. Direct descriptive updates stay within their declared scope; provenance, revision checks, protected policies, and history help preserve the basis and boundaries of accepted knowledge.

This is an opt-in beta pilot. Review every proposed change before accepting it. Usefulness on real topics, review effort, and general answer quality have not yet been established. The feature does not accept drafts automatically or expand coverage beyond declared evidence.

### More reliable graph and recall operations

Project-scoped graph refreshes and recall now preserve their selected scope through scheduling and indexing. Temporary graph reference resolution can also proceed while another SQLite connection holds the main writer, reducing busy failures during concurrent graph work.
